svg.title: One number hides the slice where it fails
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One number hides the slice where it fails” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A staircase of baseline scores climbing from random 0.4997 through one feature 0.8014 to the model 0.8991, beside a confident overall accuracy bar cracking into a strong self-serve slice at 0.9548 and a weak enterprise slice at 0.5842 whose boxes are redrawn proportional to revenue rather than row count, giving a revenue-weighted 0.8457, plus two bootstrap confidence intervals drawn against a heavy zero line and a three-box offline-shadow-online chain with two boxes still empty.
